item.title: Publicly Traded Blockchain Lender Figure Confirms Customer Data Breach
item.description: Blockchain lender Figure said hackers accessed customer data after an employee was targeted in a social engineering attack.

item.title: Bitcoin Is Down Bad, But Hasn't Yet Hit Its 'Ultimate Bear Market Bottom': Analysts
item.description: Despite its 45% fall since its October peak, Bitcoin has not yet found its bear market bottom, according to a new report from CryptoQuant.

item.title: Can Meme Coins Power a Senate Bid? Virginia’s Mark Moran Says Yes
item.description: Mark Moran is using a meme coin on Solana to elevate his U.S. Senate bid, rallying degens against a pro-crypto Democrat in Virginia.

item.title: Bitcoin Takes Step Towards Quantum Fix as Experts Diverge on Urgency of Threat
item.description: Bitcoin developers lay the groundwork for post-quantum upgrades, but experts vary on whether the threat is years or decades away.

item.title: Her Divorce Was Ugly. Crypto Became a Lifeline
item.description: A mother in Texas said that crypto helped her overcome financial abuse.

item.title: OpenClaw Creator Gets Big Offers to Acquire AI Sensation—Will It Stay Open Source?
item.description: Peter Steinberger's open-source AI agent OpenClaw hit 180,000 GitHub stars and spawned MoltBook chaos. Now Meta and OpenAI want to buy it, but he's determined to keep it free.

item.title: Hollywood’s AI Crackdown Opens Door for Copyright Detection Startups
item.description: Studios are escalating pressure on AI developers, as new tools aim to document whether generative models are trained on copyrighted material.

item.title: Bitcoin Leverage Heats Up as Traders Bet on Price Rebound
item.description: Bitcoin's futures basis has widened amid retail dip buying surges, but one expert warns the setup may end in an "over-leveraged shakeout."

item.title: UK Prime Minister Seeks New Powers to Regulate AI Chatbots as Child Safety Concerns Mount
item.description: The move would bring AI chatbots under UK online safety laws, enabling rapid age limits and feature curbs to protect children.

item.title: OpenAI Taps OpenClaw Founder to Lead Push Into Personal AI Agents
item.description: The founder said he is turning OpenClaw into a foundation, calling OpenAI the fastest way to bring open agents to everyone.
